lbl.Gli strati accesi compaiono come eti: Active layers appear as labels at the top of the map and the legend at the bottom left explains their colours. Next to each layer, buttons let you move it up or down, centre the map on its data and change its colours; the “Search layer” field filters the list. You can turn on more than one to compare them, for example buildings and cadastre.
lbl.Gli strati molto densi (come le part: Very dense layers (such as cadastral parcels) look better with WMS: WFS download has a cap of 10,000 features.
lbl.Gli strati si ricordano da una visit: Layers are remembered from one visit to the next, in this browser. If a service stops responding, it stays in the list marked as “unavailable” and is not deleted.
lbl.Gli strati sono i temi che si posson: Layers are the themes that can be overlaid on the map. On the left a vertical bar has five tabs: “Basemap”, “Layers”, “RNDT”, “My layers” and “Filters”. The “Layers” tab opens a panel with the groups of layers (Boundaries, Buildings, Monuments, PAI plan, Population, Terrain, Services, Road safety, Territory, Transport), always in alphabetical order: a click on the group opens it, and each layer has a box to turn it on or off. The panel stays open until you press the tab again or Esc; on a phone it opens from the “Layers” tab, while “My layers”, the RNDT catalogue and Geoimage are in the “Add” tab.

lbl.Grazie alla sua ottima architettura: Thanks to its excellent architecture it was possible to adapt it with very few changes: the plugin was born for another mapping application, but it is so well designed that it can be hosted here too without rewriting it.
lbl.I dati aggiunti compaiono nel gruppo: Added data appear in the “RNDT” group of the layers bar, and also among the Topics of the Info sheet. Each layer has the eye icon to turn it on or off and the bin to remove it. They are saved automatically and, when you reopen the map, they come back in place, on or off as you left them. Next to the name, “this session only” warns that the layer could not be saved.
lbl.I dati del censimento 2023 sono stim: The 2023 census data are sample estimates (permanent census): the values by section are not exact counts.
lbl.I dati del censimento sono stime cam: Census data are sample estimates, so the values by section are not exact counts.
lbl.I servizi aggiunti restano salvati n: Added services stay saved in the browser (up to fifty): a click on a row puts them back on the map, the bin removes them from the list. For protected services there are user and password fields, which stay in memory only while the page is open: when you reopen it the service shows a padlock and the password has to be entered again. For ArcGIS REST you can paste a token into the address. Data are shown within the Palermo area and the added layers appear under “Layers on the map”, with checkbox, opacity and arrows for the order.
lbl.I servizi pubblici spesso non permet: Public services often do not allow use from other websites: a small intermediate service (proxy) makes them reachable, with security checks on addresses and sizes.
lbl.I tuoi file non stanno più qui: si c: Your files are no longer here: they are loaded from the tree of the “My layers” group (the load icon next to “My data”) and appear in the same group, together with the XYZ, WMS, WMTS, WFS and ArcGIS REST services added by address, also with user and password. “Load a file from your computer” accepts: GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, GPX, Shapefile (a zip file that also includes the .prj) and CSV with latitude and longitude columns. GeoJSON and CSV must be in WGS84. Of each file only the features inside the Municipality of Palermo are kept, and a layer is saved up to 5 MB: beyond that, it only lasts while the page is open. You can also paste an https address in the “From a web address” field of “My data”: for a Google Sheets sheet, first share it with “Anyone with the link” (Viewer role) and remember the lat and lon columns; the file, at most 10 MB, is a copy that does not update itself.

lbl.Il Digital Twin di Palermo è una cop: The Palermo Digital Twin is a digital copy of the city, built with public data and open to anyone. It requires no technical skills.
lbl.Il Digital Twin di Palermo, realizza: The Palermo Digital Twin, created by Open Data Sicilia, is an interactive map that makes the data of our city available to all citizens: cadastre, zoning plan, population, buildings, monuments, public transport, road safety and municipal offices.
lbl.Il Digital Twin è uno strumento per: The Digital Twin is a tool for learning, studying and understanding the city. It does not replace official documents. Cadastre, zoning plan and constraints are purely informational here and have no legal value. For a land-registry extract or a certificate of planning use, contact SISTER or the competent offices.

lbl.Sono le scale colore scientifiche di: These are Fabio Crameri’s scientific colour maps: “perceptually uniform” colour ramps, where equal changes in the data correspond to equal visual changes. They read well even with colour vision deficiency and in black-and-white print, unlike rainbows such as “jet”, which create false bands and distort the values.
lbl.Sono usate qui per colorare i layer: They are used here to colour layers by attribute (sequential, diverging and categorical). Mapshaper includes them since version 0.7.75: 12 sequential scales (batlow, batlowW, acton, bamako, bilbao, davos, devon, lajolla, lapaz, oslo, tokyo, turku), 5 diverging (bam, broc, cork, roma, vik) and 1 categorical (batlowS).

lbl.Il pulsante con la tabella, nella ba: The table button, in the toolbar at the top right, opens the “Data table” from the bottom: the rows of the active layers, one tab per layer, like an attribute table. It shows the information loaded in the current view, so moving or zooming the map updates it; on a phone the button is in the “Layers” sheet. A layer that is switched off has no tab.
lbl.Per scegliere cosa vedere ci sono qu: Four selection tools choose what to see: “Click” picks one feature, “Box” and “Polygon” pick those inside the area you draw, “Area” picks those inside a district, a neighbourhood or a UPL. “Back to the view” returns to the rows visible on the map. The “Filter the rows” field searches the text, the column heading sorts, and the “Columns” menu shows, hides and moves columns.
lbl.Le caselle scelgono righe e colonne: The checkboxes choose the rows and columns to export; the CSV or GeoJSON button shows how many rows and columns will be written (for example “33 × 15”) and adds the layer's source and licence. Export is enabled for the City's open data whose licence allows it, such as road accidents and road safety; for the other layers, and for those you add yourself, the button stays off. The geometry of tiled layers is simplified: for precise data use the CSV.

lbl.Il pulsante con l'omino, nella barra: The little-person button, in the toolbar at the top right, switches Street View on: the cursor becomes a crosshair. Press on the point of the map you are interested in and, holding down, drag to choose the viewing direction; a blue cone shows where the panorama will look.
lbl.Al rilascio si apre una finestra con: On release a window opens with the Google Street View panorama of the point: move it by dragging the top bar, resize it from the corner and close it with the cross. “Open in Google Maps” opens it full screen in a new tab. Esc switches the tool off. Where Google has no imagery the window stays empty; the panorama is an external Google service and is not part of the map data.
lbl.Gli orari del trasporto pubblico si: Public transport timetables update automatically: every day the site checks the City's open data portal and, when AMAT publishes a new feed, stops, lines and timetables are replaced. If the feed in use has expired, the map says so.
